ModMetaData.name: TSA Prison Commons
ModMetaData.author: TSA
ModMetaData.description:
Fork of Prison Commons.
Credits: Original mod by Ben Lubar. Continued/updated by Mlie (emipa606). This fork by TSA adds RimWorld 1.7 extras (private cells, commons hangout/recreation, recruiting, temperature through bars/doors, and more). MIT license — see LICENSE.md and CREDITS.md. GitHub only; not on Steam. Do not run with Mlie.PrisonCommons.
Requires ReBuild: Doors and Corners (cell doors / cell walls for private cells next to the commons).
What it does (simple):
Private cells + a shared commons - Give each prisoner a small private cell (bed room) and a nicer shared commons next door (tables, art, recreation). Mark commons furniture as Prison Commons. Separate cells from commons with ReBuild cell doors / cell bars. - Tiny cells borrow beauty, space, wealth, and cleanliness from the adjacent commons, so the cell still feels like part of a nice prison instead of a bare box. - Proper private cells (small, owned bed rooms next to commons) make prison breaks / riots much less likely. - A pretty prison (good mood from impressiveness and commons) makes recruiting faster. - Prisoners hang out in the commons by day and can use recreation (chess, poker, etc.) for a short mood boost. That helps mood — and mood helps recruiting. - Hungry prisoners can walk to food in the commons. Cell bars keep rooms separate for prison rules but still share temperature (and gas) with the commons.
Requires Harmony + ReBuild: Doors and Corners. Soft support for DBH bathrooms (mark as Prison Commons) and VFE cell doors.
